title: Building the Eiffel Tower: lessons as we build

lines.text: Eighteen thousand iron pieces... built in about two years. Let's see how!
Every piece was drawn first, then made in a factory. A giant kit!
Two and a half million rivets... put in red hot! They shrink as they cool, and clamp tight.
Even the cranes climbed up the tower as it grew!
Finished in eighteen eighty-nine, for the World's Fair.
Voila! Not bad for an old man, eh?
